summary:
Main
Renewed price weakness suggests that the previous seaborne rebound has not translated into sustained market support.DCE most-traded closed at 677.0 yuan/mt, down 0.88%, while the 61%, 58% and 65% port indices fell to 657, 619 and 821 yuan/wmt. The seaborne 61% index eased to USD 89.50/dmt and the 65% to 108.70, narrowing the grade spread to USD 19.20. Eleven of the 12 seaborne brands declined, leaving the recovery in mainstream fines fragile.
